message.content:
For \(12 \div (x+1)\) to be an integer, \(x+1\) must be a divisor of \(12\).

The divisors of \(12\) include negative values:
\[
\pm 1, \pm 2, \pm 3, \pm 4, \pm 6, \pm 12
\]

To make \(x\) as small as possible, choose the smallest possible value of \(x+1\), which is \(-12\).

\[
x+1=-12
\]
\[
x=-13
\]

Check:
\[
12 \div (-13+1)=12\div(-12)=-1
\]
which is an integer.

The answer is -13.
